title: Untitled Quantum Game
subtitle: A quantum science game using the Unity engine

mainContent.content: A Unity prototype turning quantum science into playable mechanics. Uncertainty, observation, and state become verbs the player rehearses through 7 of 9 maps across multiple environments.

content.title: Game poster showing 7 of 9 maps, game mechanics panel, exhibition design, and hands-on play installations

mainContent.content: The poster communicates the full project scope: isometric puzzle maps, game mechanics panels, and physical exhibition installations creating a hybrid learning environment.
The isometric title screen introduces the game's visual language — quantum cubes and geometric forms set the tone for a mechanics-first learning experience.

Equations become interactive rules discovered through trial and error. Failure produces readable outcomes — wrong intuition is part of the learning path. Isometric clarity keeps focus on quantum concepts.
